name: ToyPark
summary:
ToyPark is an ever-expanding library of multiplayer activities turbocharged with rich physics-based interactions. **It is currently in Alpha and under heavy development.**

Currently, there are five activities available, with more coming soon:
1. Pans'nPistols - Deathmatch multiplayer game in which your pistols automatically reloads, frying pans can be used as weapons or shields, the world reacts as you shoot. It's a crazy, laughter-filled experience that'll have you swinging frying pans with wild excitemen
